title: Publication-agnostic Monitoring with individual Monitors
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As an editor, I want configurable Monitors that discover and revisit source material across publication niches, so that I can assess newsworthy developments without a domain-specific intake implementation.

Vision: Papyrus Monitoring is general; individual Monitors are configurations, with many per publication. RSS/Atom, bounded URL-prefix crawling and X saved searches are initial behavior tracks, subject to access validation. “Discoveries” is tentative vocabulary for discovery/provenance records. Threat Intelligence is a major consumer, not a special implementation. Optional sponsoring newsdesk/section records discovery provenance without exclusively owning a canonical Reference. Canonical deduplication retains multiple discoveries; one item can match multiple publication/Section Cyclotron outputs. Ownership, conflicts and final editorial placement are later decisions, not single-owner intake constraints.

Current hierarchy inspected: publication selection uses canonicalTopicSet.corpusKey in steering config; hosted publication mission/policies, NewsroomSection mission/policies/guidance/kill criteria, then narrower assignment/story context apply through docs/editorial-context.md. Existing siteCyclotron uses one shared site engine with Section-fit binary classifiers plus a section selector derived from curated NewsroomSection records (PPY-0a285b), with provider/review settings from relevanceCyclotron. Preserve that configuration and proof/human-label boundary; this plan does not rewrite the engine topology or treat predictions as accepted evidence/training labels. Multi-publication routing needs explicit scope/authorization design; current resolver does not infer multi-canonical ownership.

Definition of Done for later implementation: configurable many-monitor intake, safe bounded collection, canonical identity with repeatable provenance, multiple candidate routing matches, source-change re-evaluation and access/cost/licensing evidence. No implementation started. Custom scraper plugins deferred. General crawlers first; structured government adapters only when metadata warrants. Other candidate sources and niche examples are validation hypotheses, not delivery commitments. X discussion around $20 indicates interest only, not a budget promise or purchase authorization.

Latest priority and initial consumers: inbound Monitoring is Ryan's highest near-term value, independent of Markus for everything, outbound RSS/Atom and headless delivery. Initial consumers are the academic Papyrus publication, Threat Intelligence AND Anth.us, configured through the same publication-agnostic Papyrus capability rather than special implementations. Morning relevant discoveries must reach the actual configured Cyclotron classifiers with attributable classification evidence; a manual research list alone is not completion. No automatic human labels. No blocking dependency on the Markus initiative, outgoing feeds, authored-page migration or email-monitor implementation is introduced.

First small vertical slice: validate and configure a later expansion to 3–5 real sources across those consumers, prioritizing Hacker News, arXiv AI papers, the current Hugging Face paper offering, security/privacy publications and CVE/advisory sources. Final source/publication bindings are verified, not inferred. Cadence is configurable around 15 minutes where source limits and update frequency permit, with checkpoints, deduplication, new/updated-item handling, provenance and visible retryable failures. The desired “tonight or tomorrow” urgency expresses value, not permission to deploy or start coding.

Source validation evidence from this planning pass: https://huggingface.co/papers currently identifies Daily Papers (daily/weekly/monthly views) and offers email subscription; no official RSS feed, stable API contract or Papers With Code successor status was established. Validate an allowed feed/API/crawler method before selecting it. Official arXiv RSS/Atom documentation https://info.arxiv.org/help/rss.html describes subject feeds and daily updates; its cadence need not be 15 minutes. Review current source terms/rate/access requirements before implementation. HN candidates remain https://news.ycombinator.com/rss and https://github.com/HackerNews/API . No subscriptions, mailbox connections, model calls or paid access in this task.

Discovery inbox acceptance: PPY-b83f2bf0-7443-46d1-b169-5332f508efeb requires usable publication-wide, channel (e.g. all configured X/Reddit/email), individual-Monitor and section lenses over the same deduplicated References and multiple associations. Show “found by this section's Monitors” provenance separately from “relevant to this section” classifier output. Reuse Reference preview/curation and Cyclotron confidence/label controls under existing human/delegation/agent-advisory authority rules, and link Editorial triage. Settings CRUD alone is insufficient. Document and review lenses, failures and authority semantics without claiming unimplemented source adapters exist.

LATEST first milestone and implementation scope: real recurring Monitor -> persisted deduplicated References and provenance -> the correct publication's REAL Cyclotron prediction -> human review in the EXISTING curation UI -> an authorized human label under current authority rules -> verified applied steering/training receipt. Predictions, agent judgments and advisory feedback never count as human labels. Recorded, queued and applied feedback are distinct; claim training/optimization only with an applied receipt, never from prediction alone. Respect existing proof/authorization gates; do not bypass them to manufacture a receipt.

One configured Monitor per initial publication is sufficient. Start with 1–2 source adapters: Hacker News first, then a verified current Hugging Face paper/academic source only as a useful bounded increment. Initial consumers are Anth.us, the academic Papyrus publication and Threat Intelligence; exact source-to-publication mapping is flexible and one upstream source may serve multiple independently scoped classifiers. Verify current application/binding ownership and guidance; never assume legacy dbsyytcm9drqa. Pilobolus is not an initial target because its serendipitous content is harder to monitor, not because it is permanently excluded. Preserve recurring, source-appropriate cadence around 15 minutes, checkpoints, dedup/new/updated items, provenance and visible stage failures so relevant discoveries and the learning loop are available for morning review.

Rich Monitoring UI/new inbox, email/unsubscribe, expensive LLM section/desk triage and Markus for everything are MUCH LOWER priority and MUST NOT block this slice. Use existing capabilities and curation UI; choose the operator/configuration interface during implementation, with no required new configuration UI. Additional adapters, 3–5 source expansion and richer views are later increments. Reuse current scheduling/intake/classification/label paths and coordinate intake PR367 instead of duplicating it.

Ryan explicitly authorized implementation of THIS first slice after filing, with public-source intake/classification needed for it. That does not authorize production merge/deployment, new persistent access/IAM, purchases, mailbox/MX changes, subscriptions, AWS-console browser work or unrelated benchmarks. No fabricated human labels. Other new feature plans remain unstarted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan approved folding Editorial triage into the newsdesk/Monitoring planning: fast Jev/Cyclotron nomination can name several sections; a higher-capability section/desk editor uses current resolved guidance, evidence and in-progress stories for news judgment and reporting allocation. The four linked triage behavior stories preserve attributed decisions and human-label boundaries. Budgets are a prioritization requirement; dollar values, hard caps and concurrency remain undecided. Planning only; implementation remains unstarted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Planning delivery: branch develop, direct Kanbus-only commit/push per AGENTS.md; GitHub reports develop unprotected, so no PR is required. Verified all 22 new records by kbs show: types, permitted parent links, descriptions, Gherkin, open/unassigned state, provenance and dependency targets. Both delivery epics depend on the common published-content foundation. Full-board kbs validate remains at the same 15 pre-existing abbreviated dependency-target errors; no new validation errors. No code/tests/dependencies/infrastructure/deployment changes; behavior implementation and executable acceptance remain unstarted.

Pilot PPY-3212f123-2cc6-4464-b3b6-1c32bfbdda25 and behavior PPY-b8b15cfc-f06e-4f19-9574-00c3c233d56c require recurring 3–5 real-source intake, source-appropriate configurable cadence around 15 minutes, checkpoints, dedup/new/updates/provenance, actual Cyclotron decision evidence and visible failures; manual research alone is insufficient and no human labels are automatic. Email/newsletter monitoring is NEW feature epic PPY-68d06cab-8724-415e-8e6a-afdc8bdc9c9e, preserving external read-only IMAP/POP3 and publication/user-scoped SES address options; no current inbound-monitor capability is claimed. No extended email audit, activation, connection, MX change, subscription, purchase, model call or deployment. Urgency is not coding authorization.

All 54 new records and amended initiative validated through Kanbus readback; hierarchy, priorities, descriptions, Gherkin, open/unassigned state, provenance and dependencies checked. comments.author: home
comments.text: FINAL ordering: first milestone PPY-3212f1 / behavior PPY-b8b15c is recurring monitor -> persisted deduplicated Reference/provenance -> correct real publication Cyclotron prediction -> human review in existing curation UI -> authorized label -> verified APPLIED steering/training receipt. One Monitor per initial publication (Anth.us, academic Papyrus, TI); 1–2 adapters, HN first then a verified academic source only if useful. Rich UI, new inbox, email/unsubscribe, expensive desk LLM triage and Markus architecture are low priority and not blockers. Configuration UI is not required. Existing proof/authority gates remain; agent decisions never human labels. Ryan now authorizes implementing only this slice after filing, coordinating PR367, with no production merge/deployment/new IAM/purchases/mailbox/MX/subscription changes.
